monetization_evidence.evidence: The captions drive leads to paid design & build services. DP0-r7dEnme: '✨ Ready to bring calm and character into your home? Let's start your journey — https://idw.design/get-consultation'. DPoAX_tkiWR: '✨ Ready to build a home that breathes with you? Let's design it together — https://idw.design/get-consultation'.

The consultation page books 1-hour consultations and qualifies leads by income range and construction budget, from 'Below 100k' up to '800k - above' (RM). The firm is 'IDW Design Sdn Bhd', Seksyen U12, 40170 Shah Alam, Malaysia.

The firm makes scale claims on its site: '17+ Years of experience', '11,264 Home Owner. been help by IDW', '13 State Coverage'. Tagline: 'The Premier Interior Designer | Malaysian's renowned interior designer turns homes into living art masterpieces'. These are self-claims.
The captions carry a disclaimer: '📌 Transformation shown is based on conceptual visualizations. Actual project results may vary.' It appears on both DP0-r7dEnme and DPoAX_tkiWR.

content_mode_evidence: The captions label the visuals as conceptual: 'Transformation shown is based on conceptual visualizations. Actual project results may vary.' The project coded the cover frames (ESTIMATED): DP0-r7dEnme ai_generated ('photoreal but overly smooth foliage and merging details typical of AI imagery'); DPoAX_tkiWR 3d_render ('CG look of wet driveway and foliage'). The firm's website also shows real built-project house tours, so the full Instagram feed may be mixed, but the sampled reels are all conceptual visualizations (AI or CG).
niche_focus: A Malaysian interior design & build firm (landed homes, bungalows, mansions) posting modern-tropical and 'quiet luxury' conceptual home visualizations to generate consultation leads.
cta_pattern: An aspirational first line ('Where Nature Meets Modern Living 🌿'), poetic copy, then a '✨ Ready to ...?' question CTA with a direct URL (https://idw.design/get-consultation). A conceptual-visualization disclaimer follows, with branded hashtags #RichMindRichHome #IDWDesign #IDWSignature #DesignWithPurpose.
